mysteries.title: The Names at the Pantry
mysteries.question: Why do the pantry records include a name found in an older parish archive but absent from the current resident roll?
mysteries.agenda: Follow the documented discrepancy through independent records and let the player decide who needs help.
mysteries.next_pressure: Choose a route through pantry intake, Sister Catherine’s parish comparison, or the current resident roll. Ask permission and preserve another route if access is refused.

revelations.text: The same discrepancy spans current pantry intake, an older parish entry, and a missing current resident entry. It needs an explanation across records, not simply a corrected spelling.

clues.description: Inspect an anomalous pantry voucher or ask an intake witness to explain the entry. The existing public report establishes names and vouchers that do not match current RRHA records.
clues.player_summary: Pantry intake contains a legible entry that does not match the current resident records.

clues.description: Ask Sister Catherine to explain or corroborate her parish cross-check. Her publicly reported comparison found an anomalous name in an older parish archive; access to her separate ledger still requires her agreement.
clues.player_summary: Sister Catherine’s cross-check ties an anomalous intake name to an older parish record.

clues.description: Compare the reported name with current RRHA resident records through a credible records request or a knowledgeable neighborhood witness. Do not invent a named official or a specific identity in advance.
clues.player_summary: The current resident roll has no living entry matching the reported parish name.

mysteries.notes: Seeded only from public events dated 2026-09-21 through 2026-09-26 and canonical arc-013. These are available investigative routes, not completed player discoveries. No identity or hidden solution has been invented.
